title: Email Delivery Delay for US East Recipients
customerImpact: Email delivery to a subset of US East recipients delayed by up to 20 minutes. No bounces or lost messages.
investigation: Increased queue dwell time for emails routed to a single US East provider endpoint.
rootCause: The provider's US East endpoint returned intermittent 429 (rate limit) responses after their regional capacity event.
mitigation: Automatic retry backoff handled most traffic; we shifted 30% of US East email volume to the secondary provider.
monitoring: Dwell time monitored for 45 minutes after the provider recovered.
resolution: Provider recovery confirmed; delivery times returned to normal. No customer action required.
